description: The bar chart illustrates the average JGA (Joint Goal Accuracy) scores for two models — LLaMA-7B (orange bars) and T5-small (yellow bars) — across 14 distinct turn IDs (0, 2, 4, ..., 26), which likely represent sequential dialogue turns in a continual learning evaluation. The vertical axis, labeled “Avg. JGA Score,” ranges from 0.2 to 1.0 in increments of 0.1, indicating performance on a normalized scale. For each turn ID, the two models’ scores are displayed side by side, allowing direct comparison. Both models show a general downward trend in performance as turn ID increases, suggesting degradation over continual dialogue interactions. At Turn ID 0, both models achieve near-perfect scores (LLaMA-7B ≈ 0.95, T5-small ≈ 0.94). By Turn ID 26, LLaMA-7B’s score drops to approximately 0.43, while T5-small falls to about 0.33. LLaMA-7B consistently outperforms T5-small across all turn IDs, with the performance gap widening slightly in later turns. The chart includes a legend in the upper right corner identifying the color coding for each model, and the horizontal axis is labeled “Turn ID” with evenly spaced tick marks at even-numbered intervals. No error bars or statistical annotations are present, and the bars are not sorted by value but ordered chronologically by turn ID.
